name: Flood Inundation Hazard
description: Dehradun flood inundation vulnerability mapped from hydrological runoff models and historical high-water events.

name: Topographic Slope
description: Slope inclination in degrees derived from 30m Digital Elevation Model (DEM). Critical for runoff velocity and landslide susceptibility.

name: Annual Precipitation (AOI)
description: Interpolated annual isohyet rainfall across Dehradun Area of Interest (AOI).

name: Land Use / Land Cover (FR Weights)
description: Classified Land Use / Land Cover reclassified with Flood Risk (FR) weight coefficients for Dehradun urban watershed.

name: Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)
description: ln(a / tan Î²) steady-state wetness index quantifying topographic control on hydrological processes and soil saturation.

name: Topographic Position Index (TPI)
description: Difference between elevation of a central pixel and the mean elevation of its neighborhood. Identifies landforms like canyons, flats, and ridges.

name: Terrain Aspect (Orientation)
description: Compass direction that a terrain slope faces. Influences solar radiation, microclimate, and moisture retention.

name: Aspect Eastness (Sin Aspect)
description: Continuous East-West orientation component: sin(Aspect * Ï€/180). Values close to +1 face East, -1 face West.

name: Aspect Northness (Cos Aspect)
description: Continuous North-South orientation component: cos(Aspect * Ï€/180). Values close to +1 face North, -1 face South.
